svg.title: The afterstate override gate in half-folds — the frozen rule demands >= +0.01 regret gain in EACH half
svg.desc: The afterstate override gate in half-folds — the frozen rule demands >= +0.01 regret gain in EACH half. Higher is better; the frozen criterion is a gain of at least +0.01 in EACH half-fold, drawn as the third series of +0.01 markers because the generator has no reference-line primitive. All three gates FAILED the frozen rule and all three records are pilot tier with outcome fail / not-supported-as-tested. Iteration-3 K=256 (RS-20260820T184500Z-63c0a8e2, 2,689 fresh roots, 1,030 near-tie eligible, override rate 37.0%): +0.0351 / +0.0075, pooled +0.0214 — the narrowest miss; its own record warns the half2 value 0.0075 is close to the frozen margin and should be read as a narrow failure, not evidence of no effect. Full-train 22 epochs (RS-20260821T094500Z-1a7e3c55, fresh corpus-E, 2,867 roots, 1,106 eligible, 41.1% override rate): +0.0228 / -0.0297, pooled +0.0018 — the override is actively harmful in half2. D2-teacher (RS-20260821T134500Z-4b9d2f68, K=64 D2-continuation corpus, partial at 6,535 of 8,192 roots): -0.0089 / +0.0110, pooled +0.0012 — and this record carries a disclosed confound: the model was trained on D2-continuation outcomes but gated against D1-continuation outcomes, frozen for comparability. Per the frozen failure action, no further override variants of the same checkpoint were opened; the margin bars are the recorded frozen constant 0.01 from each record's gateChecks criterion text. Sources: RS-20260820T184500Z-63c0a8e2, RS-20260821T094500Z-1a7e3c55, RS-20260821T134500Z-4b9d2f68.
